name: How much does it cost to replace a failed window seal?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace a failed window seal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace a failed window seal varies based on several factors, including the window's size, type, glass features (e.g., Low-E coating, gas fill), and accessibility. Generally, replacing just the insulated glass unit is significantly less expensive than installing a brand-new window. For an accurate estimate, it's best to schedule a consultation with a local contractor who can assess your specific windows and provide a detailed quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary by window size, type, and glass features; replacing the glass unit is usually cheaper than a full window replacement.
